title: I can’t open the team files
picker_summary: New hire signs in fine but can’t open anything his manager sent.

caller.name: Lucas
caller.mood: Eager and a little nervous. Doesn't want to look bad in his first week.
caller.opening_line: Hi, I started this week. I can sign in fine, but I can’t open any of the files my manager sent me.

verification_profile.calling_from: your laptop softphone, not the mobile number HR has on file
pressure_lines: My manager wants me to read these before our meeting this afternoon.

hidden.cause: His account was created without a department and he was never added to the SG-Sales group, so he has none of the Sales team's access. Signing in works fine.

facts.fact: First week on the job. Signing in works.
He joined the Sales team. His manager is Maria.
facts.reveal_when: asked which team, department, or who his manager is

facts.fact: The links say he doesn't have access and need permission.
facts.reveal_when: asked what he sees or what the error says

facts.fact: His teammates in Sales open the same links with no problem.
facts.reveal_when: asked whether anyone else can open them

facts.fact: Maria can confirm he's on her team if IT calls or messages her.
facts.reveal_when: the technician asks for manager confirmation or approval

account: none (the tenant has no Microsoft 365 licenses)

solution.diagnosis: Provisioning gap. Department not set and not in SG-Sales. Set the department and add him to SG-Sales, with his manager's approval.

set_department.why: Keeps his account accurate for reporting and any future dynamic groups.
set_department.caller_reaction: No change he can notice on its own.

add_to_sg_sales.caller_reaction: After signing out and back in, the links open and he can see the files.

assign_license.why: The tenant has no Microsoft 365 licenses, and licensing isn't the problem.

admin_password_reset.caller_reaction: He has to change his password, and the files still don't open.

solution.on_unlisted_action: Nothing changes. The files still don't open.

diagnosis.check: Finds out what he's trying to open and what the error says
Checks his account and spots the missing department and group
Confirms Sales is the right team before granting access
Fixes it with the department and SG-Sales, not a license or password reset

verification.check: Verifies identity with an accepted method before any account change
Gets the manager's approval for the group access

communication.check: Tells him to sign out and back in for the access to apply
Explains what was wrong in plain words
Confirms he can open the files before closing

documentation.check: Notes record the verification method used
Notes record the cause and the action taken
Final status matches the expected status

critical_failures.when: Group access was granted before identity was verified with an accepted method
